main_body: A flat grass ground strip with a few sparse tufts and three small flowers (red, yellow, red)
top_band: none: a ground surface with no standing volume, so there is no top band and front face to read
evidence: The candidate is a terrain ground patch, not a standing object. It is a flat top-down grass fill with no vertical faces, so the top/front contract does not apply and nothing is drawn wrongly as an elevation or a slab.

style.evidence: The grass is one mid-green base with scattered single light and dark pixels. The tufts are small, dark-green clumps spaced far apart. Large areas well over 5x5 px are flat base green, with no mottling or patch variation. The Beodeul grass reference has broad light and dark patches, grain and tufts across every tile. Most tiles here carry only about 2-4 colours, against about 10 or more in the reference. It reads thinner and flatter than the reference.
